name: Hornero World Clock
description: Dashboard card with local, UTC and three selectable cities. Pure-JS rule-based offsets (fixed, EU, US and southern DST rules) labelled per row; no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Guard zone lookups, support vertical bar layout, and remove DST disclaimer from widget body
Catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version; it says what the extension does first.
Absorbs Dual Clock: a bar indicator with local time over a second zone (barZone, barShowSeconds) and a popover with dates, offsets and the difference.
Plain wording in footnotes and labels (no internal terms).
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: tokens and variant names ported.

Time and Agenda 2.0: dashboard card (Time category) on the shared Time facade with no own timer, three selectable city slots (defaults Buenos Aires, Madrid, Tokyo as in 1.x), EU/US/southern DST rules with per-row offset and DST labels, locale dates, typed settings and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card showing local time, UTC, and Buenos Aires, Madrid and Tokyo with pure-JS offsets (Madrid followed the EU DST rule).

city1.description: First city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city2.description: Second city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city3.description: Third city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showLocal.description: Show the local time row (the 1.x behaviour).

showSeconds.description: Show seconds in every row (the 1.x behaviour).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

barZone.description: Bar indicator: the second time zone shown under your local time.

barShowSeconds.description: Bar indicator: show seconds in the local and second-zone times.
